articles.title: Letter: the Eastgate Volunteer Fire Co. Did a Good Job This Fall
body: To the editor: Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.

To the editor: I have lived on Sycamore Road for 14 years, and I want to say what a difference the Eastgate Volunteer Fire Co. has made. Please keep the free tax clinic in the budget. Many of us on Sycamore Road use it every week.
I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the April meeting.
Vincent Rasmussen, Stonebrldge
